verdict.rationale: Zulip's docs describe a framework for interactive bots that react to messages. That is a bot-messaging capability, not the in-chat interactive UI the story asks for. Nothing in the pack shows developers can render modals, buttons or structured message layouts. The community praise for Markdown/LaTeX describes message formatting, not a developer UI component framework, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build apps with rich interactive UI inside chat — modals, buttons, and structured message layouts
